create.name: Integral Yoga Centre Gibraltar
create.bio:
The Integral Yoga Centre Gibraltar is a registered charity that has taught Integral Yoga on the Rock since 1989. It follows Sri Swami Satchidananda, whose method weaves postures, breathing, deep relaxation, chanting, meditation, philosophy and selfless service into one path, under his motto that truth is one and paths are many. Its founder and life president, Nalanie Harilela Chellaram, knew Satchidananda from childhood as a family friend and later became his student; she gives satsangs in Gibraltar, in Spain and abroad, and leads hatha and raja yoga teacher trainings. Nearly twenty volunteer teachers trained in the tradition share the teaching.

Classes take place in a studio on Town Range in the centre of Gibraltar, with some sessions also streamed on Zoom. The weekly timetable covers beginners', mixed-ability and intermediate hatha yoga, chair yoga, yoga nidra, meditation, and classes for children and expectant mothers. All classes run on a donation basis with a suggested rate, so cost is not a barrier, and the centre raises money for local and international charities through its sister project, Service in Satchidananda. A sister hall at Sotogrande, just over the border in Andalusia, hosts its residential courses.
